findings.claim: STRC 成為 2026 年比特幣邊際需求的主要來源；約 80% 持有人為散戶（單一來源）
findings.source: inter.capital — STRC: The Preferred Stock That Became Bitcoin's Marginal Bid
findings.excerpt: STRC: The Preferred Stock That Became Bitcoin’s Marginal Bid Bitcoin’s demand story in 2024 was dominated by ETF inflows. In 2025, corporate treasury buying arose along ETFs. In 2026, STRC or “Stretch” became the dominant source of marginal demand, a perpetual preferred stock issued by Strategy.
